method.venue_admission: Archived Binance rules require minimum opening notional of 5 USDT in both 2021 windows. For every ETH scope, observed best price, mark and last trade all place 0.001 ETH above 0 and below 5 USDT and 0.002 ETH above 5 USDT. Pure reductions are exempt. Admitted market sweeps use causally observed displayed price and quantity.
method.economic_scope: Use 10,000 USDT initial equity, the historic 0.04% taker fee, observed weighted market sweep prices, and signed funding at the first replay point after the exact venue settlement. Historical quotes are fixed model inputs. Closed and marked drawdown are distinct. Zero closed trades provide no win-rate estimate.
method.timing_scope: Operations take 200ms as measured in the native fixture. A separate full replay adds 200ms to each order. Original seeds were unspecified. All chosen seeds and antithetic counterparts are included on the same two dates.
